source_variant_note: Coffee tables 50475.1 and 50476.1 are printed as Emperor marble; the catalogue notes Calacatta marble (.0) availability. Only the seven explicitly selected printed references are counted.
scope_note: Only the TRIANON living-room section on PDF pages21-24 is in scope. The page21 contextual room image includes a round coffee table and tall vitrines not individually specified among these seven selected references. Those contextual items must not be labelled as the seven modelled SKUs. Later Trianon dining/bedroom sections are not part of this extraction.
provenance_note: Images are exact original embedded JPEG bytes, explicitly documented native-density crops, or faithful native-density composites of original JPEGs with their original PDF soft masks over the source white page background. Raw image and original mask bytes and hashes are retained. No AI replacement, super-resolution, new subject segmentation or subject alteration was performed.
reconstruction_caveat: Only catalogue dimensions and visibly documented surfaces are evidenced. Hidden joinery, exact fabric weave and finish calibration, marble veining placement, rear/underside structures and opening mechanisms are unverified interpretations. These images alone do not establish whether source imagery is photographed or rendered. The p23 rectangular coffee-table attribution is inferred from the shared catalogue composition and dimensions, not from a separate isolated labelled view.
rights_note: User-supplied MARINER catalogue; original product designs and imagery remain the rights of their owners. This evidence extraction conveys no commercial reuse licence or manufacturer endorsement.
